# polaris Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    polaris = { source = "ErikBPF/polaris", version = "0.1.0" }
  }
}
provider "polaris" {
  base_url = "https://polaris.example.com"
  realm    = "POLARIS"
  # Supply POLARIS_TOKEN through the environment.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Polaris HTTP(S) origin, without an API path.
- `client_id` (String) Internal Polaris OAuth client ID; ignored when token is set.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Internal Polaris OAuth client secret; ignored when token is set.
- `realm` (String) Polaris realm.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Prefetched bearer token; external tokens are not refreshed.
